source: https://huggingface.co/intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (workbook ID 103, retrieved 2026-10-06; raw/hf_intfloat_multilingual-e5-small.md, YAML metadata removed)

modelDetails.architecture: 12 layers, embedding size 384, initialized from microsoft/Multilingual-MiniLM-L12-H384
modelDetails.description: Multilingual-E5-small encodes queries and passages as text embeddings for retrieval and similarity tasks in 100 languages.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Passage retrieval in open question answering and ad-hoc information retrieval; semantic similarity; bitext mining and paraphrase retrieval; embeddings as features for linear probing classification and clustering

evaluation.datasets: Mr. TyDi; BEIR and MTEB benchmarks
evaluation.performance: Average MRR@10 of 64.4 on Mr. TyDi, against 33.3 for BM25, 16.7 for mDPR and 70.5 for multilingual-e5-large

trainingData.algorithm: Contrastive pre-training with weak supervision followed by supervised fine-tuning, InfoNCE loss with temperature 0.01
trainingData.dataset: First stage: filtered mC4, CC News, NLLB, Wikipedia, filtered Reddit, S2ORC, Stackexchange, xP3 and miscellaneous unsupervised SBERT data; second stage: MS MARCO, NQ, Trivia QA, NLI from SimCSE, ELI5, DuReader Retrieval, KILT Fever, KILT HotpotQA, SQuAD, Quora, Mr. TyDi and MIRACL (training sets only)
trainingData.procedure: Initialization from microsoft/Multilingual-MiniLM-L12-H384, then two stages: contrastive pre-training with weak supervision and supervised fine-tuning

ethicalConsiderations.limitations: Long texts are truncated to at most 512 tokens; low-resource languages may see performance degradation

modelCardContent.caveatsAndRecommendations: Add the prefixes "query: " and "passage: " to input texts as in training, otherwise performance degrades: use both for asymmetric tasks such as passage retrieval and "query: " only for symmetric tasks and for features; compare relative order of cosine similarity scores rather than absolute values, which fall between 0.7 and 1.0
